5.1 packages/KNIRVSERVER/pkg/knirvagent/inner/session.go NEW

Defines the InnerAgentSession struct which wraps a PTY-launched CLI process.

package inner

import (
    "io"
    "os"
    "os/exec"
    "sync"
    "time"

    "github.com/creack/pty"
)

type SessionStatus string

const (
    StatusStarting SessionStatus = "starting"
    StatusRunning  SessionStatus = "running"
    StatusExited   SessionStatus = "exited"
)

type InnerAgentSession struct {
    ID            string
    ToolName      string        // "claude", "aider", "codex", etc.
    Cmd           *exec.Cmd
    PTY           *os.File      // pseudo-terminal master fd
    Status        SessionStatus
    StartedAt     time.Time
    WorkspaceDir  string
    DVEID         string

    // supervisorLog captures every byte the inner agent writes.
    // All output is tee'd: one copy to supervisorLog, one to subscribers.
    supervisorLog io.Writer

    mu            sync.RWMutex
    subscribers   []chan []byte // one per WebSocket subscriber
    done          chan struct{}
}

// Subscribe returns a channel that receives every byte written by the inner agent.
// The caller must drain the channel; it is closed when the session exits.
func (s *InnerAgentSession) Subscribe() chan []byte {
    ch := make(chan []byte, 256)
    s.mu.Lock()
    s.subscribers = append(s.subscribers, ch)
    s.mu.Unlock()
    return ch
}

// Unsubscribe removes a subscriber channel.
func (s *InnerAgentSession) Unsubscribe(ch chan []byte) { /* remove from slice */ }

// broadcast fans out a chunk to all subscriber channels and the supervisor log.
func (s *InnerAgentSession) broadcast(chunk []byte) {
    s.supervisorLog.Write(chunk)
    s.mu.RLock()
    defer s.mu.RUnlock()
    for _, ch := range s.subscribers {
        select {
        case ch <- append([]byte(nil), chunk...):
        default: // drop if subscriber is slow
        }
    }
}

// pumpOutput reads from the PTY and fans out to subscribers until the process exits.
func (s *InnerAgentSession) pumpOutput() {
    buf := make([]byte, 4096)
    for {
        n, err := s.PTY.Read(buf)
        if n > 0 {
            s.broadcast(buf[:n])
        }
        if err != nil {
            break
        }
    }
    s.mu.Lock()
    s.Status = StatusExited
    for _, ch := range s.subscribers {
        close(ch)
    }
    s.subscribers = nil
    s.mu.Unlock()
    close(s.done)
}

5.2 packages/KNIRVSERVER/pkg/knirvagent/inner/manager.go NEW

Manages the lifecycle of all inner agent sessions within a single DVE instance. Each KNIRVAGENT process instantiates one InnerAgentManager. 

package inner

import (
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "os/exec"
    "sync"
    "time"

    "github.com/creack/pty"
    "github.com/google/uuid"
)

type InnerAgentManager struct {
    mu           sync.RWMutex
    sessions     map[string]*InnerAgentSession
    catalog      *ToolCatalog
    workspaceDir string
    dveID        string
    logDir       string   // supervisor logs written here, one file per session
}

func NewInnerAgentManager(dveID, workspaceDir, logDir string) *InnerAgentManager {
    return &InnerAgentManager{
        sessions:     make(map[string]*InnerAgentSession),
        catalog:      DefaultCatalog(),
        workspaceDir: workspaceDir,
        dveID:        dveID,
        logDir:       logDir,
    }
}

// Spawn launches a new inner agent session, allocates a PTY, and starts pumping output.
func (m *InnerAgentManager) Spawn(toolName string, env []string) (*InnerAgentSession, error) {
    tool, ok := m.catalog.Lookup(toolName)
    if !ok {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown tool: %s", toolName)
    }
    if !tool.IsInstalled() {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("tool %s is not installed; call Install first", toolName)
    }

    sessionID := uuid.NewString()
    logFile, err := os.Create(fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s.log", m.logDir, sessionID))
    if err != nil {
        return nil, err
    }

    cmd := exec.Command(tool.Binary, tool.DefaultArgs...)
    cmd.Dir = m.workspaceDir
    cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), env...)
    DefaultSpawnHooks(cmd, m.dveID, sessionID)

    ptmx, err := pty.Start(cmd)
    if err != nil {
        logFile.Close()
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("pty.Start: %w", err)
    }

    sess := &InnerAgentSession{
        ID:            sessionID,
        ToolName:      toolName,
        Cmd:           cmd,
        PTY:           ptmx,
        Status:        StatusRunning,
        StartedAt:     time.Now(),
        WorkspaceDir:  m.workspaceDir,
        DVEID:         m.dveID,
        supervisorLog: logFile,
        done:          make(chan struct{}),
    }

    m.mu.Lock()
    m.sessions[sessionID] = sess
    m.mu.Unlock()

    go sess.pumpOutput()
    return sess, nil
}

// SendInput writes raw bytes (keystrokes) to the session's PTY master.
func (m *InnerAgentManager) SendInput(sessionID string, data []byte) error {
    sess := m.get(sessionID)
    if sess == nil {
        return fmt.Errorf("session %s not found", sessionID)
    }
    _, err := sess.PTY.Write(data)
    return err
}

// Install runs the tool's install command inside the DVE workspace shell.
func (m *InnerAgentManager) Install(toolName string) error {
    tool, ok := m.catalog.Lookup(toolName)
    if !ok {
        return fmt.Errorf("unknown tool: %s", toolName)
    }
    return tool.Install(m.workspaceDir)
}

func (m *InnerAgentManager) Terminate(sessionID string) error { /* SIGTERM → SIGKILL */ return nil }
func (m *InnerAgentManager) List() []*InnerAgentSession { /* snapshot */ return nil }
func (m *InnerAgentManager) get(id string) *InnerAgentSession { /* RLock lookup */ return nil }

package server

// RegisterInnerRoutes adds all inner-agent HTTP endpoints to the existing router.
// Called from the KNIRVAGENT binary's main HTTP server setup, after the existing routes.
func RegisterInnerRoutes(r *mux.Router, mgr *inner.InnerAgentManager) {
    r.HandleFunc("/api/inner/spawn", handleSpawn(mgr)).Methods("POST")
    r.HandleFunc("/api/inner/install", handleInstall(mgr)).Methods("POST")
    r.HandleFunc("/api/inner/sessions", handleListSessions(mgr)).Methods("GET")
    r.HandleFunc("/api/inner/tools", handleListTools(mgr)).Methods("GET")
    r.HandleFunc("/api/inner/{sessionId}", handleTerminate(mgr)).Methods("DELETE")
    r.HandleFunc("/api/inner/{sessionId}/input", handleSendInput(mgr)).Methods("POST")
    r.HandleFunc("/api/inner/{sessionId}/stream", handleStream(mgr)).Methods("GET")
    r.HandleFunc("/api/inner/{sessionId}/log", handleGetLog(mgr)).Methods("GET")
}

// handleStream serves a long-lived chunked HTTP response that streams raw PTY output.
// The KNIRVSERVER backend's DVEInnerAgentWSHandler consumes this and bridges to WebSocket.
func handleStream(mgr *inner.InnerAgentManager) http.HandlerFunc {
    return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        sessionID := mux.Vars(r)["sessionId"]
        sess, err := mgr.GetSession(sessionID)
        if err != nil {
            http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
            return
        }

        w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream")
        w.Header().Set("Transfer-Encoding", "chunked")
        w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
        w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)

        ch := sess.Subscribe()
        defer sess.Unsubscribe(ch)

        flusher, _ := w.(http.Flusher)
        for {
            select {
            case chunk, ok := <-ch:
                if !ok {
                    return
                }
                if _, err := w.Write(chunk); err != nil {
                    return
                }
                if flusher != nil {
                    flusher.Flush()
                }
            case <-r.Context().Done():
                return
            }
        }
    }
}

6.1 backend/internal/web/dve_inner_agent_ws_handler.go NEW

Upgrades the browser WebSocket at /ws/dve/{nodeId}/inner/{sessionId}, then reads the raw PTY stream from agent-{dveId}.sock via AgentManager.GetInnerSessionStream() and fans out to the browser. Input from the browser is forwarded to POST /api/inner/{sessionId}/input. 

package web

import (
    "context"
    "encoding/json"
    "io"
    "log"
    "net/http"
    "time"

    "github.com/gorilla/mux"
    "github.com/gorilla/websocket"
)

type DVEInnerAgentWSHandler struct {
    agentManager AgentManagerInterface // same interface as supervisor handler
}

func NewDVEInnerAgentWSHandler(mgr AgentManagerInterface) *DVEInnerAgentWSHandler {
    return &DVEInnerAgentWSHandler{agentManager: mgr}
}

func (h *DVEInnerAgentWSHandler) HandleWebSocket(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    vars := mux.Vars(r)
    nodeID := vars["nodeId"]
    sessionID := vars["sessionId"]

    socketPath, err := h.agentManager.GetSocketPathForDVE(nodeID)
    if err != nil {
        http.Error(w, "no agent socket for DVE", http.StatusNotFound)
        return
    }

    conn, err := upgrader.Upgrade(w, r, nil)
    if err != nil {
        return
    }
    defer conn.Close()

    unixClient := newUnixSocketClient(socketPath, 0) // no timeout — streaming

    // Open the PTY stream from KNIRVAGENT inner session.
    streamCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(r.Context())
    defer cancel()

    streamURL := "http://localhost/api/inner/" + sessionID + "/stream"
    req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(streamCtx, "GET", streamURL, nil)
    resp, err := unixClient.Do(req)
    if err != nil {
        conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, []byte(`{"type":"error","data":"session stream unavailable"}`))
        return
    }
    defer resp.Body.Close()

    // goroutine: PTY stream → WebSocket
    go func() {
        buf := make([]byte, 4096)
        for {
            n, err := resp.Body.Read(buf)
            if n > 0 {
                msg, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]interface{}{
                    "type": "data",
                    "data": string(buf[:n]),
                })
                conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second))
                conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, msg)
            }
            if err != nil { cancel(); return }
        }
    }()

    // main loop: WebSocket input → /api/inner/{sessionId}/input
    for {
        _, message, err := conn.ReadMessage()
        if err != nil { break }
        var msg struct {
            Type string `json:"type"`
            Data string `json:"data"`
        }
        if json.Unmarshal(message, &msg) != nil || msg.Type != "input" { continue }
        go forwardInnerInput(unixClient, sessionID, []byte(msg.Data))
    }
}

The helper newWebSocketProxy must be added to packages/KNIRVGATEWAY/internal/server/server.go. It tunnels raw TCP over the Unix socket so WebSocket framing passes through unmodified: 

// newWebSocketProxy creates an HTTP handler that tunnels WebSocket connections
// through a Unix socket without stripping Upgrade headers.
func newWebSocketProxy(socketPath string) http.Handler {
    return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        backendConn, err := net.Dial("unix", socketPath)
        if err != nil {
            http.Error(w, "backend unavailable", http.StatusBadGateway)
            return
        }
        defer backendConn.Close()

        // Hijack the client connection for raw bidirectional copy.
        hijacker, ok := w.(http.Hijacker)
        if !ok {
            http.Error(w, "hijacking not supported", http.StatusInternalServerError)
            return
        }
        clientConn, buf, err := hijacker.Hijack()
        if err != nil {
            return
        }
        defer clientConn.Close()

        // Replay buffered data then copy bidirectionally.
        r.Write(backendConn)
        if buf.Reader().Buffered() > 0 {
            io.CopyN(backendConn, buf, int64(buf.Reader().Buffered()))
        }
        done := make(chan struct{}, 2)
        go func() { io.Copy(backendConn, clientConn); done <- struct{}{}; }()
        go func() { io.Copy(clientConn, backendConn); done <- struct{}{}; }()
        <-done
    })
}

9. Complete Data Flow

9.1 Spawning an Inner Agent Session

1
User clicks "+" in the DVE workspace → ToolPickerModal opens, user selects "claude".
2
If not installed: frontend calls POST /api/v1/dve/{id}/inner/install (through KNIRVGATEWAY TCP → backend.sock → inner_agent_handlers.go → AgentManager → POST /api/inner/install on agent-{dveID}.sock → inner/manager.go runs npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code).
3
Frontend calls POST /api/v1/dve/{id}/inner/spawn → same proxy chain → inner/manager.go Spawn() → pty.Start(cmd) allocates PTY, launches claude process, starts pumpOutput() goroutine. Returns {id:"<sessionID>"}.
4
Frontend opens new tab, renders InnerAgentTerminal, opens WebSocket to wss://host:8888/ws/dve/{nodeId}/inner/{sessionId}.
5
KNIRVGATEWAY newWebSocketProxy(backend.sock) tunnels raw TCP to backend.sock → DVEInnerAgentWSHandler upgrades WS and opens chunked GET to http://localhost/api/inner/{sessionId}/stream on agent-{dveID}.sock.
6
handleStream() in inner_routes.go calls sess.Subscribe() → reads from subscriber channel → writes chunks to HTTP response. DVEInnerAgentWSHandler reads chunks and wraps as {"type":"data","data":"..."} JSON frames sent to browser WebSocket.
7
Browser xterm.js renders the PTY output. User keystrokes → {"type":"input","data":"k"} → backend → POST /api/inner/{sessionId}/input → sess.PTY.Write([]byte("k")).

9.2 Supervisor Monitoring (Tee Pattern)

1
Every byte the inner agent writes to its PTY master is read by pumpOutput() in inner/session.go.
2
broadcast(chunk) writes to supervisorLog (a file at {logDir}/{sessionID}.log) and fans out to all subscriber channels.
3
The supervisor can retrieve the full log via GET /api/inner/{sessionId}/log at any time. The supervisor's own /api/execute endpoint can reference session logs for context-aware oversight.
4
Future: supervisor can inject text into the inner agent's PTY via sess.PTY.Write() to guide, correct, or terminate misbehaving inner agents.

25	// killStaleAgent sends SIGTERM (then SIGKILL after 2 s) to any running
26	// processes whose executable matches the given binary name.
27	func killStaleAgent(binaryPath string) {
28		if binaryPath == "" {
29			return
30		}
31		binaryName := filepath.Base(binaryPath)
32		if cmd := exec.Command("pkill", "-TERM", "-x", binaryName); cmd.Run() == nil {
33			time.Sleep(1 * time.Second)
34		}
35		exec.Command("pkill", "-KILL", "-x", binaryName).Run() //nolint:errcheck
36	}

38	// waitForPortFree blocks until the given TCP port is no longer occupied or
39	// the deadline is reached. Returns true if the port is free.
40	func waitForPortFree(port int, deadline time.Duration) bool {
41		end := time.Now().Add(deadline)
42		for time.Now().Before(end) {
43			ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", fmt.Sprintf(":%d", port))
44			if err == nil {
45				ln.Close()
46				return true
47			}
48			time.Sleep(200 * time.Millisecond)
49		}
50		return false
51	}

110	// waitForSocket blocks until the given Unix socket file exists or the
111	// deadline is reached. Returns true when the socket is ready.
112	func waitForSocket(socketPath string, deadline time.Duration) bool {
113		end := time.Now().Add(deadline)
114		for time.Now().Before(end) {
115			if _, err := os.Stat(socketPath); err == nil {
116				// Socket file exists — verify it's actually listening
117				conn, err := net.DialTimeout("unix", socketPath, 100*time.Millisecond)
118				if err == nil {
119					conn.Close()
120					return true
121				}
122			}
123			time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
124		}
125		return false

214		}

227	// StartAgent spawns a new KNIRVAGENT subprocess for the given DVE ID.
228	// It blocks until the agent's socket is ready (up to StartTimeout).
229	func (am *AgentManager) StartAgent(ctx context.Context, dveID string, startTimeout time.Duration) (*AgentProcess, error) {
230		am.mu.Lock()
231	
232		// Check if already running
233		if existing, ok := am.agents[dveID]; ok && existing.isHealthy() {
234			am.mu.Unlock()
235			am.logger.Info("Agent already running for DVE", zap.String("dveID", dveID))
236			return existing, nil
237		}
238	
239		// Check max concurrent limit
240		if len(am.agents) >= am.maxConcurrent {
241			am.mu.Unlock()
242			return nil, fmt.Errorf("max concurrent agents reached (%d/%d)",
243				len(am.agents), am.maxConcurrent)
244		}
245	
246		resolvedPath := am.binaryPath
247		if resolvedPath == "" {
248			var err error
249			resolvedPath, err = resolveBinaryPath("./knirvagent")
250			if err != nil {
251				am.mu.Unlock()
252				return nil, fmt.Errorf("KNIRVAGENT binary not found: %w", err)
253			}
254		}
255	
256		if am.socketDir != "" {
257			if err := os.MkdirAll(am.socketDir, 0755); err != nil {
258				am.mu.Unlock()
259				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create socket dir %s: %w", am.socketDir, err)
260			}
261		}
262	
263		socketPath := filepath.Join(am.socketDir, fmt.Sprintf("agent-%s.sock", dveID))
264	
265		// Kill any stale instance for this DVE
266		killStaleAgent(resolvedPath)
267		os.Remove(socketPath)
268	
269		am.logger.Info("Starting KNIRVAGENT for DVE",
270			zap.String("dveID", dveID),
271			zap.String("socket", socketPath),
272			zap.String("binary", resolvedPath))
273	
274		// Build command — the agent runs the `server` subcommand which listens
275		// on a Unix socket (agent-{dveID}.sock) and exposes POST /api/execute.
276		args := []string{
277			"server",
278			"--dve-id", dveID,
279			"--socket-path", socketPath,
280		}
281	
282		cmd := exec.Command(resolvedPath, args...)
283		cmd.Env = os.Environ()
284		cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, am.extraEnv...)
285		cmd.Stdout = os.Stdout
286		cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr
287		cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{
288			Setpgid: true,
289		}
290	
291		if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
292			am.mu.Unlock()
293			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to start KNIRVAGENT for DVE %s: %w", dveID, err)
294		}
295	
296		pid := cmd.Process.Pid
297	
298		ap := &AgentProcess{
299			DVEID:      dveID,
300			Cmd:        cmd,
301			SocketPath: socketPath,
302			PID:        pid,
303			StartedAt:  time.Now(),
304			Healthy:    false,
305		}
306	
307		am.agents[dveID] = ap
308		am.mu.Unlock()
309	
310		// Wait for the socket to appear (outside the lock)
311		if startTimeout <= 0 {
312			startTimeout = 30 * time.Second
313		}
314		if !waitForSocket(socketPath, startTimeout) {
315			// Socket didn't appear — kill the process group
316			syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
317			am.mu.Lock()
318			delete(am.agents, dveID)
319			am.mu.Unlock()
320			return nil, fmt.Errorf("timeout waiting for agent socket %s for DVE %s", socketPath, dveID)
321		}
322	
323		ap.setHealthy(true)
324	
325		am.logger.Info("KNIRVAGENT started for DVE",
326			zap.String("dveID", dveID),
327			zap.Int("pid", pid),
328			zap.String("socket", socketPath))
329	
330		return ap, nil
331	}

333	// StopAgent stops the agent subprocess for the given DVE ID.
334	func (am *AgentManager) StopAgent(dveID string, stopTimeout time.Duration) error {
335		am.mu.Lock()
336		ap, ok := am.agents[dveID]
337		if !ok {
338			am.mu.Unlock()
339			return nil // idempotent — already stopped
340		}
341		delete(am.agents, dveID)
342		am.mu.Unlock()
343	
344		if ap.Cmd == nil || ap.Cmd.Process == nil {
345			os.Remove(ap.SocketPath)
346			return nil
347		}
348	
349		am.logger.Info("Stopping KNIRVAGENT for DVE",
350			zap.String("dveID", dveID),
351			zap.Int("pid", ap.PID))
352	
353		// Send SIGTERM
354		if err := ap.Cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGTERM); err != nil {
355			am.logger.Warn("Failed to send SIGTERM to agent, forcing kill",
356				zap.String("dveID", dveID),
357				zap.Error(err))
358			syscall.Kill(-ap.Cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
359		}
360	
361		done := make(chan error, 1)
362		go func() {
363			done <- ap.Cmd.Wait()
364		}()
365	
366		if stopTimeout <= 0 {
367			stopTimeout = 10 * time.Second
368		}
369	
370		select {
371		case <-done:
372			ap.setHealthy(false)
373			os.Remove(ap.SocketPath)
374			am.logger.Info("KNIRVAGENT stopped for DVE", zap.String("dveID", dveID))
375			return nil
376		case <-time.After(stopTimeout):
377			am.logger.Warn("Timeout waiting for agent shutdown, forcing kill",
378				zap.String("dveID", dveID))
379			syscall.Kill(-ap.Cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
380			ap.setHealthy(false)
381			os.Remove(ap.SocketPath)
382			return fmt.Errorf("forced shutdown of agent for DVE %s after timeout", dveID)
383		}
384	}

424		am.mu.RLock()
425		dveIDs := make([]string, 0, len(am.agents))

438		errCh := make(chan error, len(dveIDs))
439	
440		for _, dveID := range dveIDs {
441			wg.Add(1)
442			go func(id string) {
443				defer wg.Done()
444				if err := am.StopAgent(id, 10*time.Second); err != nil {
445					errCh <- err
446				}
447			}(dveID)
448		}
449	
450		doneCh := make(chan struct{})
451		go func() {
452			wg.Wait()
453			close(doneCh)
454		}()
455	
456		select {
457		case <-doneCh:
458			close(errCh)
459			// Collect any errors
460			var errs []error
461			for err := range errCh {
462				errs = append(errs, err)
463			}
464			if len(errs) > 0 {
465				return fmt.Errorf("errors stopping agents: %v", errs)
466			}
467			return nil
468		case <-ctx.Done():
469			return fmt.Errorf("timeout stopping all agents: %w", ctx.Err())
470		case <-time.After(15 * time.Second):
471			return fmt.Errorf("timeout stopping all agents after 15s")
472		}
473	}

475	// HealthCheck pings the agent's socket for the given DVE.
476	func (am *AgentManager) HealthCheck(dveID string) bool {
477		ap, err := am.GetAgent(dveID)
478		if err != nil {
479			return false
480		}
481	
482		client := &http.Client{
483			Timeout: 3 * time.Second,
484			Transport: &http.Transport{
485				DialContext: func(ctx context.Context, _, _ string) (net.Conn, error) {
486					return net.DialTimeout("unix", ap.SocketPath, 2*time.Second)
487				},
488			},
489		}
490	
491		resp, err := client.Get("http://localhost/health")
492		if err != nil {
493			ap.setHealthy(false)
494			return false
495		}
496		defer resp.Body.Close()
497	
498		healthy := resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK
499		ap.setHealthy(healthy)
500		return healthy
501	}

506		if err != nil {

508		}

514					return net.DialTimeout("unix", ap.SocketPath, 2*time.Second)

534	// StartPeriodicHealthCheck starts a goroutine that periodically checks
535	// all agents and reaps any that are unhealthy.
536	func (am *AgentManager) StartPeriodicHealthCheck(ctx context.Context) {
537		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
538		am.stopHealthCheck = cancel
539	
540		am.wg.Add(1)
541		go func() {
542			defer am.wg.Done()
543			ticker := time.NewTicker(am.healthInterval)
544			defer ticker.Stop()
545	
546			for {
547				select {
548				case <-ctx.Done():
549					return
550				case <-ticker.C:
551					am.reapUnhealthy()
552				}
553			}
554		}()
555	
556		am.logger.Info("Periodic agent health check started",
557			zap.Duration("interval", am.healthInterval))
558	}

561	func (am *AgentManager) StopPeriodicHealthCheck() {

563			am.stopHealthCheck()
564		}
565		am.wg.Wait()

568	// reapUnhealthy checks all agents and removes any whose process has exited
569	// or whose socket is gone.
570	func (am *AgentManager) reapUnhealthy() {
571		am.mu.RLock()
572		snapshot := make([]*AgentProcess, 0, len(am.agents))
573		for _, ap := range am.agents {
574			snapshot = append(snapshot, ap)
575		}
576		am.mu.RUnlock()
577	
578		for _, ap := range snapshot {
579			// Check if socket still exists
580			if _, err := os.Stat(ap.SocketPath); os.IsNotExist(err) {
581				am.logger.Warn("Agent socket missing, reaping",
582					zap.String("dveID", ap.DVEID),
583					zap.String("socket", ap.SocketPath))
584				am.mu.Lock()
585				// Re-check inside lock to avoid race
586				if existing, ok := am.agents[ap.DVEID]; ok && existing.SocketPath == ap.SocketPath {
587					delete(am.agents, ap.DVEID)
588				}
589				am.mu.Unlock()
590				continue
591			}
592	
593			// Check if process is still alive
594			if ap.Cmd != nil && ap.Cmd.Process != nil {
595				if err := ap.Cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.Signal(0)); err != nil {
596					// Process is gone
597					am.logger.Warn("Agent process exited, reaping",
598						zap.String("dveID", ap.DVEID),
599						zap.Int("pid", ap.PID))
600					ap.setHealthy(false)
601					os.Remove(ap.SocketPath)
602					am.mu.Lock()
603					if existing, ok := am.agents[ap.DVEID]; ok && existing.PID == ap.PID {
604						delete(am.agents, ap.DVEID)
605					}
606					am.mu.Unlock()
607				}
608			}
609		}
610	}

684	// serverCmd starts an HTTP server on a Unix socket that accepts command
685	// execution requests. Designed for use as a managed subprocess by KNIRVSERVER's
686	// AgentManager — each DVE gets its own agent process with its own socket.
687	//
688	// Usage: knirvagent server --dve-id <id> --socket-path <path>
689	func serverCmd() {
690		dveID := ""
691		socketPath := ""
692	
693		args := os.Args[2:]
694		for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
695			switch args[i] {
696			case "--dve-id":
697				if i+1 < len(args) {
698					dveID = args[i+1]
699					i++
700				}
701			case "--socket-path":
702				if i+1 < len(args) {
703					socketPath = args[i+1]
704					i++
705				}
706			case "--debug", "-d":
707				logger.SetLevel(logger.DEBUG)
708			case "--help", "-h":
709				fmt.Println("Usage: knirvagent server --dve-id <id> --socket-path <path>")
710				fmt.Println()
711				fmt.Println("Starts the agent as an HTTP server on a Unix socket.")
712				fmt.Println("Accepts POST /api/execute for command execution,")
713				fmt.Println("GET /health for health checks.")
714				return
715			}
716		}
717	
718		if socketPath == "" {
719			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: --socket-path is required\n")
720			os.Exit(1)
721		}
722	
723		// Remove any existing socket file
724		os.Remove(socketPath)
725	
726		cfg, err := loadConfig()
727		if err != nil {
728			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error loading config: %v\n", err)
729			os.Exit(1)
730		}
731	
732		// Debug: log what the config actually has after loading
733		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: cfg.Providers.Gemini.APIKey=%q (len=%d)\n",
734			cfg.Providers.Gemini.APIKey, len(cfg.Providers.Gemini.APIKey))
735		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: cfg.Providers.DeepSeek.APIKey=%q (len=%d)\n",
736			cfg.Providers.DeepSeek.APIKey, len(cfg.Providers.DeepSeek.APIKey))
737		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: cfg.Providers.ShengSuanYun.APIKey=%q (len=%d)\n",
738			cfg.Providers.ShengSuanYun.APIKey, len(cfg.Providers.ShengSuanYun.APIKey))
739		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: cfg.Providers.OpenRouter.APIKey=%q (len=%d)\n",
740			cfg.Providers.OpenRouter.APIKey, len(cfg.Providers.OpenRouter.APIKey))
741		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider=%q\n",
742			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider)
743		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model=%q\n",
744			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model)
745	
746		// Debug: log whether API keys are available as env vars
747		for _, key := range []string{"GEMINI_API_KEY", "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY", "CEREBRAS_API_KEY", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "OPENAI_API_KEY"} {
748			if val, ok := os.LookupEnv(key); ok && val != "" {
749				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: %s is set (len=%d)\n", key, len(val))
750			} else if ok {
751				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: %s is set but EMPTY\n", key)
752			} else {
753				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: %s is NOT SET\n", key)
754			}
755		}
756	
757		provider, err := createProviderWithFallback(cfg)
758		if err != nil {
759			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error creating provider: %v\n", err)
760			os.Exit(1)
761		}
762	
763		// Build runtime fallback providers so the agent can switch on auth errors.
764		// We pre-create each provider here (at startup) so there's no overhead at
765		// the time of the actual fallback.
766		runtimeFallbacks := buildRuntimeFallbacks(cfg)
767	
768		// Validate the primary provider with a quick test call and promote the
769		// first working fallback when the primary key is invalid.  This runs before
770		// the socket is created so the parent (AgentManager) always sees the
771		// correct provider name in the health endpoint.
772		provider, runtimeFallbacks = validateAndPromoteProvider(provider, cfg, runtimeFallbacks)
773	
774		// Create the Unix socket FIRST, before any potentially-blocking agent
775		// initialization.  This ensures the parent (AgentManager.StartAgent)
776		// sees the socket immediately via waitForSocket, avoiding the 30-second
777		// timeout that would otherwise kill the agent process.
778		listener, err := net.Listen("unix", socketPath)
779		if err != nil {
780			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error listening on socket %s: %v\n", socketPath, err)
781			os.Exit(1)
782		}
783		defer listener.Close()
784		defer os.Remove(socketPath)
785	
786		// Set permissions so the backend_server can connect
787		os.Chmod(socketPath, 0666)
788	
789		msgBus := bus.NewMessageBus()
790		agentLoop := agent.NewAgentLoop(cfg, msgBus, provider)
791		agentLoop.SetFallbackProviders(runtimeFallbacks)
792	
793		// Start the agent loop in the background
794		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
795		defer cancel()
796		go agentLoop.Run(ctx)
797	
798		// Print startup info
799		startupInfo := agentLoop.GetStartupInfo()
800		toolsInfo := startupInfo["tools"].(map[string]interface{})
801		skillsInfo := startupInfo["skills"].(map[string]interface{})
802		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DVE=%s socket=%s tools=%d skills=%d/%d\n",
803			dveID, socketPath, toolsInfo["count"], skillsInfo["available"], skillsInfo["total"])
804	
805		mux := http.NewServeMux()
806		mux.HandleFunc("/health", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
807			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
808			json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{
809				"status":   "ok",
810				"dve_id":   dveID,
811				"provider": cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider,
812				"model":    cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model,
813			})
814		})
815		mux.HandleFunc("/api/execute", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
816			if r.Method != "POST" {
817				http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
818				return
819			}
820	
821			var req struct {
822				Command string `json:"command"`
823			}
824			if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
825				json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{
826					"success": false,
827					"error":   "invalid request: " + err.Error(),
828				})
829				return
830			}
831	
832			if req.Command == "" {
833				json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{
834					"success": false,
835					"error":   "command is required",
836				})
837				return
838			}
839	
840			// Use the HTTP request's context so that if the caller (KNIRVSERVER
841			// WebSocket proxy) disconnects or times out, the LLM call is cancelled
842			// rather than continuing to consume the server-wide context.
843			response, err := agentLoop.ProcessDirect(r.Context(), req.Command, dveID+":terminal")
844			if err != nil {
845				json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{
846					"success": false,
847					"error":   err.Error(),
848				})
849				return
850			}
851	
852			json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{
853				"success": true,
854				"output":  response,
855			})
856		})
857	
858		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Listening on %s\n", socketPath)
859	
860		// Serve until shutdown signal
861		sigChan := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
862		signal.Notify(sigChan, os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
863	
864		go func() {
865			<-sigChan
866			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Shutting down...\n")
867			cancel()
868			listener.Close()
869		}()
870	
871		if err := http.Serve(listener, mux); err != nil {
872			if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "use of closed network connection") {
873				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Server error: %v\n", err)
874			}
875		}
876	
877		agentLoop.Stop()
878		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Stopped\n")
879	}

881	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
882	// Provider fallback — try configured provider first, then fall back through
883	// alternative providers that have API keys configured.  This lets the agent
884	// start even when the default model (gemini-2.0-flash / Gemini) has no key
885	// but other providers (DeepSeek, ShengSuanYun, OpenAI, etc.) do.
886	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
887	
888	// providerFallback defines one candidate in the fallback chain.
889	type providerFallback struct {
890		Provider string
891		Model    string // empty means leave the model at whatever CreateProvider picks
892	}
893	
894	// defaultFallbackChain is the order of providers to try, from most preferred
895	// to least.  The first entry is always the user-configured provider/model.
896	var defaultFallbackChain = []providerFallback{
897		// Entry 0 is a sentinel — filled in at runtime with the configured provider/model.
898		{Provider: "", Model: ""},
899		{Provider: "deepseek", Model: "deepseek-chat"},
900		{Provider: "shengsuanyun", Model: ""},
901		{Provider: "openai", Model: "gpt-4o-mini"},
902		{Provider: "anthropic", Model: "claude-sonnet-4-20250514"},
903		{Provider: "groq", Model: "llama-3.3-70b-versatile"},
904		// Last resort — use OpenRouter if any key is set.  It proxies many models.
905		{Provider: "openrouter", Model: "google/gemini-2.0-flash"},
906	}
907	
908	// hasAPIKeyFor returns true when the given provider has a non-empty API key
909	// in the config.  This avoids attempting provider creation only to fail again.
910	func hasAPIKeyFor(cfg *config.Config, providerName string) bool {
911		switch strings.ToLower(providerName) {
912		case "gemini", "google":
913			return cfg.Providers.Gemini.APIKey != ""
914		case "deepseek":
915			return cfg.Providers.DeepSeek.APIKey != ""
916		case "shengsuanyun", "cerebras":
917			return cfg.Providers.ShengSuanYun.APIKey != ""
918		case "openai", "gpt":
919			return cfg.Providers.OpenAI.APIKey != "" || cfg.Providers.OpenAI.AuthMethod != ""
920		case "anthropic", "claude":
921			return cfg.Providers.Anthropic.APIKey != "" || cfg.Providers.Anthropic.AuthMethod != ""
922		case "openrouter":
923			return cfg.Providers.OpenRouter.APIKey != ""
924		case "groq":
925			return cfg.Providers.Groq.APIKey != ""
926		case "vllm":
927			return cfg.Providers.VLLM.APIBase != ""
928		default:
929			return false
930		}
931	}
932	
933	// createProviderWithFallback tries the configured provider first.  If it
934	// fails (e.g. no API key for the default model), it walks the fallback chain
935	// looking for a provider with an available API key.  When a fallback succeeds,
936	// it updates cfg.Agents.Defaults so the rest of the agent (subagent manager,
937	// context builder, etc.) uses the correct provider and model.
938	func createProviderWithFallback(cfg *config.Config) (providers.LLMProvider, error) {
939		// Build the chain starting with the user-configured provider/model.
940		chain := make([]providerFallback, len(defaultFallbackChain))
941		copy(chain, defaultFallbackChain)
942		chain[0] = providerFallback{
943			Provider: cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider,
944			Model:    cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model,
945		}
946	
947		origProvider := cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider
948		origModel := cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model
949	
950		for i, fb := range chain {
951			if fb.Provider == "" {
952				continue
953			}
954			if !hasAPIKeyFor(cfg, fb.Provider) {
955				continue
956			}
957	
958			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider = fb.Provider
959			if fb.Model != "" {
960				cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = fb.Model
961			}
962	
963			provider, err := providers.CreateProvider(cfg)
964			if err == nil {
965				if i > 0 {
966					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr,
967						"[KNIRVAGENT] Provider %q (model: %q) unavailable, "+
968							"falling back to %q (model: %q)\n",
969						chain[0].Provider, chain[0].Model,
970						fb.Provider, cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model)
971				}
972				return provider, nil
973			}
974	
975			// Restore before trying the next fallback
976			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider = origProvider
977			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = origModel
978		}
979	
980		// Every provider failed — build a helpful error message
981		var available []string
982		for _, fb := range chain {
983			if fb.Provider != "" && hasAPIKeyFor(cfg, fb.Provider) {
984				available = append(available, fb.Provider)
985			}
986		}
987		if len(available) > 0 {
988			return nil, fmt.Errorf(
989				"no usable provider: %q has no valid API key (models %q), "+
990					"and fallback providers failed. "+
991					"Available providers with keys: %v",
992				chain[0].Provider, chain[0].Model, available)
993		}
994		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
995			"no API keys configured for any provider. "+
996				"Ensure root.key contains at least one API key "+
997				"(Gemini, DeepSeek, etc.)")
998	}

1000	// isStartupAuthError returns true when an API call error indicates an
1001	// invalid or missing key (HTTP 400/401/403) rather than a transient failure.
1002	func isStartupAuthError(err error) bool {
1003		msg := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
1004		return strings.Contains(msg, "400") ||
1005			strings.Contains(msg, "401") ||
1006			strings.Contains(msg, "403") ||
1007			strings.Contains(msg, "invalid api key") ||
1008			strings.Contains(msg, "api key not found") ||
1009			strings.Contains(msg, "api_key_invalid") ||
1010			strings.Contains(msg, "unauthorized") ||
1011			strings.Contains(msg, "permission denied")
1012	}
1013	
1014	// validateAndPromoteProvider makes a minimal test call to the primary provider.
1015	// If it fails with an auth error, each fallback is tried in order and the first
1016	// working one is promoted to primary — its entry is removed from the returned
1017	// fallback slice and cfg.Agents.Defaults is updated accordingly.
1018	// Non-auth failures (rate limits, network issues) are logged but do not trigger
1019	// promotion, so the agent still starts and may recover at runtime.
1020	func validateAndPromoteProvider(
1021		primary providers.LLMProvider,
1022		cfg *config.Config,
1023		fallbacks []agent.FallbackEntry,
1024	) (providers.LLMProvider, []agent.FallbackEntry) {
1025		testMsg := []providers.Message{{Role: "user", Content: "reply with: ok"}}
1026		testOpts := map[string]interface{}{"max_tokens": 5}
1027	
1028		valCtx, valCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
1029		_, primaryErr := primary.Chat(valCtx, testMsg, nil, cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model, testOpts)
1030		valCancel()
1031	
1032		if primaryErr == nil {
1033			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Provider %q passed auth validation\n", cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider)
1034			return primary, fallbacks
1035		}
1036	
1037		if !isStartupAuthError(primaryErr) {
1038			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Warning: primary provider %q test failed (non-auth, may recover): %v\n",
1039				cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider, primaryErr)
1040			return primary, fallbacks
1041		}
1042	
1043		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Primary provider %q auth error at startup: %v — testing fallbacks\n",
1044			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider, primaryErr)
1045	
1046		for i, fb := range fallbacks {
1047			fbCtx, fbCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
1048			_, err := fb.Provider.Chat(fbCtx, testMsg, nil, fb.Model, testOpts)
1049			fbCancel()
1050	
1051			if err == nil {
1052				cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider = fb.Name
1053				cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = fb.Model
1054				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Promoted %q (model: %q) as primary provider\n", fb.Name, fb.Model)
1055				// Remove the promoted entry from fallbacks
1056				remaining := make([]agent.FallbackEntry, 0, len(fallbacks)-1)
1057				remaining = append(remaining, fallbacks[:i]...)
1058				remaining = append(remaining, fallbacks[i+1:]...)
1059				return fb.Provider, remaining
1060			}
1061			if isStartupAuthError(err) {
1062				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Fallback %q auth error, skipping\n", fb.Name)
1063			} else {
1064				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Fallback %q test failed (non-auth): %v, skipping\n", fb.Name, err)
1065			}
1066		}
1067	
1068		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] No fallback passed auth validation — continuing with %q (may fail at runtime)\n",
1069			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider)
1070		return primary, fallbacks
1071	}

1073	// buildRuntimeFallbacks pre-creates all fallback providers (excluding the
1074	// one already chosen as primary) so the AgentLoop can switch at runtime when
1075	// an auth error occurs.  Providers with no API key are silently skipped.
1076	func buildRuntimeFallbacks(cfg *config.Config) []agent.FallbackEntry {
1077		primaryProvider := strings.ToLower(cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider)
1078		origProvider := cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider
1079		origModel := cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model
1080	
1081		var entries []agent.FallbackEntry
1082		for _, fb := range defaultFallbackChain[1:] {
1083			if fb.Provider == "" {
1084				continue
1085			}
1086			if strings.EqualFold(fb.Provider, primaryProvider) {
1087				continue // already the primary
1088			}
1089			if !hasAPIKeyFor(cfg, fb.Provider) {
1090				continue
1091			}
1092	
1093			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider = fb.Provider
1094			if fb.Model != "" {
1095				cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = fb.Model
1096			} else {
1097				cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = origModel
1098			}
1099	
1100			p, err := providers.CreateProvider(cfg)
1101			if err != nil {
1102				cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider = origProvider
1103				cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = origModel
1104				continue
1105			}
1106	
1107			model := cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model
1108			entries = append(entries, agent.FallbackEntry{
1109				Provider: p,
1110				Model:    model,
1111				Name:     fb.Provider,
1112			})
1113	
1114			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider = origProvider
1115			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = origModel
1116		}
1117	
1118		return entries
1119	}

KNIRV Agentic Hierarchy — Implementation Specification

Two-Tier Supervisor + Inner Agent Architecture for DVE Workspaces
Status: DRAFT — for human and agent review
Scope: packages/KNIRVAGENT · packages/KNIRVSERVER · packages/KNIRVGATEWAY · Frontend
Communication: Unix Sockets (internal) · KNIRVGATEWAY proxy (public)
Date: 2026-05-16
Overview Existing Architecture Sockets KNIRVAGENT Manager Backend Gateway Frontend Data Flow Order

1. Overview

Each DVE is auto-provisioned with a dedicated KNIRVAGENT supervisor process on DVE creation. This spec extends that architecture so the KNIRVAGENT supervisor can spawn, monitor, and proxy arbitrary inner agent CLI tools (e.g. claude, aider, codex) inside the DVE workspace. The frontend gains a multi-pane terminal workspace where each inner agent session occupies its own tab alongside the supervisor tab.

Design Principles

  • All internal communication uses Unix sockets — no TCP between services.
  • KNIRVGATEWAY (:8888) is the sole public-facing proxy. All browser-reachable endpoints must pass through it.
  • New inner agent library code belongs in packages/KNIRVAGENT/pkg/inner/ and packages/KNIRVAGENT/pkg/server/ — the binary's own module (github.com/knirvcorp/knirvagent).
  • The KNIRVAGENT binary's HTTP server (serverCmd() in cmd/knirvagent/main.go) is extended with new /api/inner/* endpoints, still served over the existing per-DVE Unix socket.
  • KNIRVSERVER manages connections to KNIRVAGENT via packages/KNIRVSERVER/pkg/knirvagent/manager.go — new proxy helper methods are added there to call the inner endpoints.
  • Every byte written by an inner agent is tee'd: one copy to a supervisor log file, one to subscriber channels (WebSocket streams).

    DVEID        string

    supervisorLog io.Writer    // written by broadcast(); every byte tee'd here

    mu          sync.RWMutex
    subscribers []chan []byte  // one channel per active /stream consumer
    done        chan struct{}
}

// Subscribe returns a channel that receives every PTY output chunk.
// Closed when the session exits. Caller must drain it.
func (s *InnerAgentSession) Subscribe() chan []byte {
    ch := make(chan []byte, 256)
    s.mu.Lock()
    s.subscribers = append(s.subscribers, ch)
    s.mu.Unlock()
    return ch
}

func (s *InnerAgentSession) Unsubscribe(ch chan []byte) {
    s.mu.Lock()
    defer s.mu.Unlock()
    for i, sub := range s.subscribers {
        if sub == ch {
            s.subscribers = append(s.subscribers[:i], s.subscribers[i+1:]...)
            return
        }
    }
}

// broadcast tees a PTY output chunk: supervisor log + all subscriber channels.
func (s *InnerAgentSession) broadcast(chunk []byte) {
    s.supervisorLog.Write(chunk)
    s.mu.RLock()
    defer s.mu.RUnlock()
    for _, ch := range s.subscribers {
        select {
        case ch <- append([]byte(nil), chunk...):
        default: // drop if subscriber is slow
        }
    }
}

// PumpOutput reads from the PTY master and fans out until the process exits.
// Run as a goroutine immediately after Spawn.
func (s *InnerAgentSession) PumpOutput() {
    buf := make([]byte, 4096)
    for {
        n, err := s.PTY.Read(buf)
        if n > 0 {
            s.broadcast(buf[:n])
        }
        if err != nil { break }
    }
    s.mu.Lock()
    s.Status = StatusExited
    for _, ch := range s.subscribers { close(ch) }
    s.subscribers = nil
    s.mu.Unlock()
    close(s.done)
}

package inner

import (
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "sync"
    "time"

    "github.com/creack/pty"
    "github.com/google/uuid"
)

type InnerAgentManager struct {
    mu           sync.RWMutex
    sessions     map[string]*InnerAgentSession
    catalog      *ToolCatalog
    workspaceDir string
    dveID        string
    logDir       string  // {workspaceDir}/.supervisor-logs/
}

func NewInnerAgentManager(dveID, workspaceDir string) *InnerAgentManager {
    logDir := workspaceDir + "/.supervisor-logs"
    os.MkdirAll(logDir, 0755)
    return &InnerAgentManager{
        sessions:     make(map[string]*InnerAgentSession),
        catalog:      DefaultCatalog(),
        workspaceDir: workspaceDir,
        dveID:        dveID,
        logDir:       logDir,
    }
}

// Spawn launches an inner agent CLI tool with a PTY, wires supervisor tee, starts output pump.
func (m *InnerAgentManager) Spawn(toolName string, extraEnv []string) (*InnerAgentSession, error) {
    tool, ok := m.catalog.Lookup(toolName)
    if !ok {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown tool: %s", toolName)
    }
    if !tool.IsInstalled() {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("tool %s not installed; call Install first", toolName)
    }

    sessionID := uuid.NewString()
    logFile, err := os.Create(fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s.log", m.logDir, sessionID))
    if err != nil { return nil, err }

    cmd := tool.BuildCmd(m.workspaceDir, extraEnv)
    DefaultSpawnHooks(cmd, m.dveID, sessionID)

    ptmx, err := pty.Start(cmd)
    if err != nil { logFile.Close(); return nil, fmt.Errorf("pty.Start: %w", err) }

    sess := &InnerAgentSession{
        ID:            sessionID,
        ToolName:      toolName,
        Cmd:           cmd,
        PTY:           ptmx,
        Status:        StatusRunning,
        StartedAt:     time.Now(),
        WorkspaceDir:  m.workspaceDir,
        DVEID:         m.dveID,
        supervisorLog: logFile,
        done:          make(chan struct{}),
    }

    m.mu.Lock()
    m.sessions[sessionID] = sess
    m.mu.Unlock()

    go sess.PumpOutput()
    return sess, nil
}

// SendInput writes raw bytes (keystrokes) to the session's PTY master.
func (m *InnerAgentManager) SendInput(sessionID string, data []byte) error {
    sess := m.get(sessionID)
    if sess == nil { return fmt.Errorf("session %s not found", sessionID) }
    _, err := sess.PTY.Write(data)
    return err
}

// Install runs the tool's install command inside the DVE workspace directory.
func (m *InnerAgentManager) Install(toolName string) error {
    tool, ok := m.catalog.Lookup(toolName)
    if !ok { return fmt.Errorf("unknown tool: %s", toolName) }
    return tool.Install(m.workspaceDir)
}

func (m *InnerAgentManager) Terminate(sessionID string) error {
    sess := m.get(sessionID)
    if sess == nil { return nil }
    if sess.Cmd != nil && sess.Cmd.Process != nil {
        sess.Cmd.Process.Kill()
    }
    sess.PTY.Close()
    m.mu.Lock()
    delete(m.sessions, sessionID)
    m.mu.Unlock()
    return nil
}

func (m *InnerAgentManager) GetSession(id string) (*InnerAgentSession, error) {
    sess := m.get(id)
    if sess == nil { return nil, fmt.Errorf("session %s not found", id) }
    return sess, nil
}

func (m *InnerAgentManager) ListSessions() []*InnerAgentSession {
    m.mu.RLock()
    defer m.mu.RUnlock()
    out := make([]*InnerAgentSession, 0, len(m.sessions))
    for _, s := range m.sessions { out = append(out, s) }
    return out
}

func (m *InnerAgentManager) ListTools() []Tool { return m.catalog.All() }

func (m *InnerAgentManager) get(id string) *InnerAgentSession {
    m.mu.RLock()
    defer m.mu.RUnlock()
    return m.sessions[id]
}

package server

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "io"
    "net/http"
    "os"
    "strings"

    "github.com/knirvcorp/knirvagent/pkg/inner"
)

// RegisterInnerRoutes attaches all /api/inner/* handlers to an http.ServeMux.
// Called from cmd/knirvagent/main.go serverCmd() after existing routes are registered.
func RegisterInnerRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux, mgr *inner.InnerAgentManager) {
    mux.HandleFunc("/api/inner/spawn",    handleSpawn(mgr))
    mux.HandleFunc("/api/inner/install",  handleInstall(mgr))
    mux.HandleFunc("/api/inner/sessions", handleListSessions(mgr))
    mux.HandleFunc("/api/inner/tools",    handleListTools(mgr))
    mux.HandleFunc("/api/inner/",         handleSessionRouter(mgr)) // routes /api/inner/{id}/*
}

// handleSessionRouter dispatches /api/inner/{sessionId}/input, /stream, /log and DELETE /api/inner/{sessionId}.
func handleSessionRouter(mgr *inner.InnerAgentManager) http.HandlerFunc {
    return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        // path: /api/inner/{sessionId}[/action]
        rest := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api/inner/")
        parts := strings.SplitN(rest, "/", 2)
        sessionID := parts[0]
        action := ""
        if len(parts) == 2 { action = parts[1] }

        switch {
        case r.Method == "DELETE" && action == "":
            mgr.Terminate(sessionID)
            w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
        case action == "input" && r.Method == "POST":
            data, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, 4096))
            mgr.SendInput(sessionID, data)
            w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
        case action == "stream" && r.Method == "GET":
            handleStream(mgr, sessionID, w, r)
        case action == "log" && r.Method == "GET":
            handleGetLog(mgr, sessionID, w)
        default:
            http.NotFound(w, r)
        }
    }
}

// handleStream is a long-lived chunked response; subscriber channel drains PTY output.
func handleStream(mgr *inner.InnerAgentManager, sessionID string, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    sess, err := mgr.GetSession(sessionID)
    if err != nil { http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound); return }

    w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream")
    w.Header().Set("Transfer-Encoding", "chunked")
    w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
    w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)

    flusher, _ := w.(http.Flusher)
    ch := sess.Subscribe()
    defer sess.Unsubscribe(ch)

    for {
        select {
        case chunk, ok := <-ch:
            if !ok { return }
            if _, err := w.Write(chunk); err != nil { return }
            if flusher != nil { flusher.Flush() }
        case <-r.Context().Done():
            return
        }
    }
}

func handleGetLog(mgr *inner.InnerAgentManager, sessionID string, w http.ResponseWriter) {
    sess, err := mgr.GetSession(sessionID)
    if err != nil { http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound); return }
    logPath := sess.WorkspaceDir + "/.supervisor-logs/" + sessionID + ".log"
    data, err := os.ReadFile(logPath)
    if err != nil { http.Error(w, "log not found", http.StatusNotFound); return }
    w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/plain")
    w.Write(data)
}

7.1 backend/internal/web/dve_inner_agent_ws_handler.go NEW

Upgrades browser WebSocket at /ws/dve/{nodeId}/inner/{sessionId}. Uses AgentManager.GetInnerSessionStream() to open the chunked PTY stream from agent-{dveID}.sock, then fans raw bytes to the browser as {"type":"data","data":"..."} JSON frames. Inbound browser keystrokes are forwarded to AgentManager.SendInnerInput(). 

package web

// Route registered in api_router.go:
// r.HandleFunc("/ws/dve/{nodeId}/inner/{sessionId}", innerWSHandler.HandleWebSocket)

func (h *DVEInnerAgentWSHandler) HandleWebSocket(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    vars := mux.Vars(r)
    nodeID, sessionID := vars["nodeId"], vars["sessionId"]

    if _, err := h.agentManager.GetSocketPathForDVE(nodeID); err != nil {
        http.Error(w, "no agent for DVE", http.StatusNotFound); return
    }

    conn, err := upgrader.Upgrade(w, r, nil)
    if err != nil { return }
    defer conn.Close()

    streamCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(r.Context())
    defer cancel()

    stream, err := h.agentManager.GetInnerSessionStream(streamCtx, nodeID, sessionID)
    if err != nil {
        conn.WriteJSON(map[string]string{"type": "error", "data": err.Error()})
        return
    }
    defer stream.Close()

    // goroutine: PTY stream → WebSocket send
    go func() {
        buf := make([]byte, 4096)
        for {
            n, err := stream.Read(buf)
            if n > 0 {
                conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second))
                conn.WriteJSON(map[string]string{"type": "data", "data": string(buf[:n])})
            }
            if err != nil { cancel(); return }
        }
    }()

    // main loop: browser input → SendInnerInput
    for {
        _, raw, err := conn.ReadMessage()
        if err != nil { break }
        var msg struct{ Type, Data string }
        if json.Unmarshal(raw, &msg) == nil && msg.Type == "input" {
            inputCtx, c := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
            h.agentManager.SendInnerInput(inputCtx, nodeID, sessionID, []byte(msg.Data))
            c()
        }
    }
}

Critical Pre-Requisite — WebSocket Proxy Gap

packages/KNIRVGATEWAY/internal/server/server.go proxies /api/v1/* to backend.sock but has no rule for /ws/*. Browser WebSocket connections to wss://host:8888/ws/dve/{nodeId}/agent (supervisor) and the new wss://host:8888/ws/dve/{nodeId}/inner/{sessionId} are silently dropped. This must be fixed first.

packages/KNIRVGATEWAY/internal/server/server.go MODIFIED

Standard httputil.ReverseProxy strips Upgrade and Connection headers, breaking WebSockets. The fix uses raw TCP hijacking to tunnel the WebSocket framing through the Unix socket without modification. 

// In setupRoutes() — AFTER the existing /api/v1/ proxy rule:

// ── existing ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
backendProxy := newSocketProxy(cfg.BackendSocketPath, "")
r.PathPrefix("/api/v1/").Handler(backendProxy)

// ── ADD: WebSocket tunnel to backend.sock ─────────────────────────────────
// httputil.ReverseProxy cannot handle WebSocket upgrades — use raw TCP tunnel.
r.PathPrefix("/ws/").HandlerFunc(newWebSocketTunnel(cfg.BackendSocketPath))

// ── new helper function to add to server.go ───────────────────────────────
func newWebSocketTunnel(socketPath string) http.HandlerFunc {
    return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        backendConn, err := net.Dial("unix", socketPath)
        if err != nil {
            http.Error(w, "backend unavailable", http.StatusBadGateway)
            return
        }
        defer backendConn.Close()

        hijacker, ok := w.(http.Hijacker)
        if !ok { http.Error(w, "hijacking not supported", http.StatusInternalServerError); return }
        clientConn, buf, err := hijacker.Hijack()
        if err != nil { return }
        defer clientConn.Close()

        // Replay the original HTTP request to the backend.
        r.Write(backendConn)
        if n := buf.Reader().Buffered(); n > 0 {
            io.CopyN(backendConn, buf, int64(n))
        }

        // Bidirectional copy — both sides run concurrently; first done cancels both.
        done := make(chan struct{}, 2)
        go func() { io.Copy(backendConn, clientConn); done <- struct{}{}{}() }()
        go func() { io.Copy(clientConn, backendConn); done <- struct{}{}{}() }()
        <-done
    }
}

Two-Tier Supervisor + Inner Agent Architecture for DVE Workspaces
Status: DRAFT — for human and agent review
Scope: packages/KNIRVAGENT · packages/KNIRVSERVER · packages/KNIRVGATEWAY · Frontend

Overview Existing Architecture Sockets KNIRVAGENT Manager Backend Gateway Frontend Data Flow Order

1. Overview

Each DVE is auto-provisioned with a dedicated KNIRVAGENT supervisor process on DVE creation. This spec extends that architecture so the KNIRVAGENT supervisor can spawn, monitor, and proxy arbitrary inner agent CLI tools (e.g. claude, aider, codex) inside the DVE workspace. The frontend gains a multi-pane terminal workspace where each inner agent session occupies its own tab alongside the supervisor tab.

Design Principles

  • All internal communication uses Unix sockets — no TCP between services.
  • KNIRVGATEWAY (:8888) is the sole public-facing proxy. All browser-reachable endpoints must pass through it.
  • New inner agent library code belongs in packages/KNIRVAGENT/pkg/inner/ and packages/KNIRVAGENT/pkg/server/ — the binary's own module (github.com/knirvcorp/knirvagent).
  • The KNIRVAGENT binary's HTTP server (serverCmd() in cmd/knirvagent/main.go) is extended with new /api/inner/* endpoints, still served over the existing per-DVE Unix socket.
  • KNIRVSERVER manages connections to KNIRVAGENT via packages/KNIRVSERVER/pkg/knirvagent/manager.go — new proxy helper methods are added there to call the inner endpoints.
  • Every byte written by an inner agent is tee'd: one copy to a supervisor log file, one to subscriber channels (WebSocket streams).

package inner

import (
    "io"
    "os"
    "os/exec"
    "sync"
    "time"
)

type SessionStatus string

const (
    StatusRunning SessionStatus = "running"
    StatusExited  SessionStatus = "exited"
)

type InnerAgentSession struct {
    ID           string
    ToolName     string
    Cmd          *exec.Cmd
    PTY          *os.File       // PTY master fd — write = keystrokes, read = output
    Status       SessionStatus
    StartedAt    time.Time
    WorkspaceDir string
    DVEID        string

    supervisorLog io.Writer    // written by broadcast(); every byte tee'd here

    mu          sync.RWMutex
    subscribers []chan []byte  // one channel per active /stream consumer
    done        chan struct{}
}

// Subscribe returns a channel that receives every PTY output chunk.
// Closed when the session exits. Caller must drain it.
func (s *InnerAgentSession) Subscribe() chan []byte {
    ch := make(chan []byte, 256)
    s.mu.Lock()
    s.subscribers = append(s.subscribers, ch)
    s.mu.Unlock()
    return ch
}

func (s *InnerAgentSession) Unsubscribe(ch chan []byte) {
    s.mu.Lock()
    defer s.mu.Unlock()
    for i, sub := range s.subscribers {
        if sub == ch {
            s.subscribers = append(s.subscribers[:i], s.subscribers[i+1:]...)
            return
        }
    }
}

// broadcast tees a PTY output chunk: supervisor log + all subscriber channels.
func (s *InnerAgentSession) broadcast(chunk []byte) {
    s.supervisorLog.Write(chunk)
    s.mu.RLock()
    defer s.mu.RUnlock()
    for _, ch := range s.subscribers {
        select {
        case ch <- append([]byte(nil), chunk...):
        default: // drop if subscriber is slow
        }
    }
}

// PumpOutput reads from the PTY master and fans out until the process exits.
// Run as a goroutine immediately after Spawn.
func (s *InnerAgentSession) PumpOutput() {
    buf := make([]byte, 4096)
    for {
        n, err := s.PTY.Read(buf)
        if n > 0 {
            s.broadcast(buf[:n])
        }
        if err != nil { break }
    }
    s.mu.Lock()
    s.Status = StatusExited
    for _, ch := range s.subscribers { close(ch) }
    s.subscribers = nil
    s.mu.Unlock()
    close(s.done)
}

package inner

import (
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "sync"
    "time"

    "github.com/creack/pty"
    "github.com/google/uuid"
)

type InnerAgentManager struct {
    mu           sync.RWMutex
    sessions     map[string]*InnerAgentSession
    catalog      *ToolCatalog
    workspaceDir string
    dveID        string
    logDir       string  // {workspaceDir}/.supervisor-logs/
}

func NewInnerAgentManager(dveID, workspaceDir string) *InnerAgentManager {
    logDir := workspaceDir + "/.supervisor-logs"
    os.MkdirAll(logDir, 0755)
    return &InnerAgentManager{
        sessions:     make(map[string]*InnerAgentSession),
        catalog:      DefaultCatalog(),
        workspaceDir: workspaceDir,
        dveID:        dveID,
        logDir:       logDir,
    }
}

// Spawn launches an inner agent CLI tool with a PTY, wires supervisor tee, starts output pump.
func (m *InnerAgentManager) Spawn(toolName string, extraEnv []string) (*InnerAgentSession, error) {
    tool, ok := m.catalog.Lookup(toolName)
    if !ok {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown tool: %s", toolName)
    }
    if !tool.IsInstalled() {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("tool %s not installed; call Install first", toolName)
    }

    sessionID := uuid.NewString()
    logFile, err := os.Create(fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s.log", m.logDir, sessionID))
    if err != nil { return nil, err }

    cmd := tool.BuildCmd(m.workspaceDir, extraEnv)
    DefaultSpawnHooks(cmd, m.dveID, sessionID)

    ptmx, err := pty.Start(cmd)
    if err != nil { logFile.Close(); return nil, fmt.Errorf("pty.Start: %w", err) }

    sess := &InnerAgentSession{
        ID:            sessionID,
        ToolName:      toolName,
        Cmd:           cmd,
        PTY:           ptmx,
        Status:        StatusRunning,
        StartedAt:     time.Now(),
        WorkspaceDir:  m.workspaceDir,
        DVEID:         m.dveID,
        supervisorLog: logFile,
        done:          make(chan struct{}),
    }

    m.mu.Lock()
    m.sessions[sessionID] = sess
    m.mu.Unlock()

    go sess.PumpOutput()
    return sess, nil
}

// SendInput writes raw bytes (keystrokes) to the session's PTY master.
func (m *InnerAgentManager) SendInput(sessionID string, data []byte) error {
    sess := m.get(sessionID)
    if sess == nil { return fmt.Errorf("session %s not found", sessionID) }
    _, err := sess.PTY.Write(data)
    return err
}

// Install runs the tool's install command inside the DVE workspace directory.
func (m *InnerAgentManager) Install(toolName string) error {
    tool, ok := m.catalog.Lookup(toolName)
    if !ok { return fmt.Errorf("unknown tool: %s", toolName) }
    return tool.Install(m.workspaceDir)
}

func (m *InnerAgentManager) Terminate(sessionID string) error {
    sess := m.get(sessionID)
    if sess == nil { return nil }
    if sess.Cmd != nil && sess.Cmd.Process != nil {
        sess.Cmd.Process.Kill()
    }
    sess.PTY.Close()
    m.mu.Lock()
    delete(m.sessions, sessionID)
    m.mu.Unlock()
    return nil
}

func (m *InnerAgentManager) GetSession(id string) (*InnerAgentSession, error) {
    sess := m.get(id)
    if sess == nil { return nil, fmt.Errorf("session %s not found", id) }
    return sess, nil
}

func (m *InnerAgentManager) ListSessions() []*InnerAgentSession {
    m.mu.RLock()
    defer m.mu.RUnlock()
    out := make([]*InnerAgentSession, 0, len(m.sessions))
    for _, s := range m.sessions { out = append(out, s) }
    return out
}

func (m *InnerAgentManager) ListTools() []Tool { return m.catalog.All() }

func (m *InnerAgentManager) get(id string) *InnerAgentSession {
    m.mu.RLock()
    defer m.mu.RUnlock()
    return m.sessions[id]
}

type Tool struct {

package server

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "io"
    "net/http"
    "os"
    "strings"

    "github.com/knirvcorp/knirvagent/pkg/inner"
)

// RegisterInnerRoutes attaches all /api/inner/* handlers to an http.ServeMux.
// Called from cmd/knirvagent/main.go serverCmd() after existing routes are registered.
func RegisterInnerRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux, mgr *inner.InnerAgentManager) {
    mux.HandleFunc("/api/inner/spawn",    handleSpawn(mgr))
    mux.HandleFunc("/api/inner/install",  handleInstall(mgr))
    mux.HandleFunc("/api/inner/sessions", handleListSessions(mgr))
    mux.HandleFunc("/api/inner/tools",    handleListTools(mgr))
    mux.HandleFunc("/api/inner/",         handleSessionRouter(mgr)) // routes /api/inner/{id}/*
}

// handleSessionRouter dispatches /api/inner/{sessionId}/input, /stream, /log and DELETE /api/inner/{sessionId}.
func handleSessionRouter(mgr *inner.InnerAgentManager) http.HandlerFunc {
    return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        // path: /api/inner/{sessionId}[/action]
        rest := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api/inner/")
        parts := strings.SplitN(rest, "/", 2)
        sessionID := parts[0]
        action := ""
        if len(parts) == 2 { action = parts[1] }

        switch {
        case r.Method == "DELETE" && action == "":
            mgr.Terminate(sessionID)
            w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
        case action == "input" && r.Method == "POST":
            data, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, 4096))
            mgr.SendInput(sessionID, data)
            w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
        case action == "stream" && r.Method == "GET":
            handleStream(mgr, sessionID, w, r)
        case action == "log" && r.Method == "GET":
            handleGetLog(mgr, sessionID, w)
        default:
            http.NotFound(w, r)
        }
    }
}

// handleStream is a long-lived chunked response; subscriber channel drains PTY output.
func handleStream(mgr *inner.InnerAgentManager, sessionID string, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    sess, err := mgr.GetSession(sessionID)
    if err != nil { http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound); return }

    w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream")
    w.Header().Set("Transfer-Encoding", "chunked")
    w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
    w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)

    flusher, _ := w.(http.Flusher)
    ch := sess.Subscribe()
    defer sess.Unsubscribe(ch)

    for {
        select {
        case chunk, ok := <-ch:
            if !ok { return }
            if _, err := w.Write(chunk); err != nil { return }
            if flusher != nil { flusher.Flush() }
        case <-r.Context().Done():
            return
        }
    }
}

func handleGetLog(mgr *inner.InnerAgentManager, sessionID string, w http.ResponseWriter) {
    sess, err := mgr.GetSession(sessionID)
    if err != nil { http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound); return }
    logPath := sess.WorkspaceDir + "/.supervisor-logs/" + sessionID + ".log"
    data, err := os.ReadFile(logPath)
    if err != nil { http.Error(w, "log not found", http.StatusNotFound); return }
    w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/plain")
    w.Write(data)
}

7.1 backend/internal/web/dve_inner_agent_ws_handler.go NEW

Upgrades browser WebSocket at /ws/dve/{nodeId}/inner/{sessionId}. Uses AgentManager.GetInnerSessionStream() to open the chunked PTY stream from agent-{dveID}.sock, then fans raw bytes to the browser as {"type":"data","data":"..."} JSON frames. Inbound browser keystrokes are forwarded to AgentManager.SendInnerInput(). 

package web

// Route registered in api_router.go:
// r.HandleFunc("/ws/dve/{nodeId}/inner/{sessionId}", innerWSHandler.HandleWebSocket)

func (h *DVEInnerAgentWSHandler) HandleWebSocket(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    vars := mux.Vars(r)
    nodeID, sessionID := vars["nodeId"], vars["sessionId"]

    if _, err := h.agentManager.GetSocketPathForDVE(nodeID); err != nil {
        http.Error(w, "no agent for DVE", http.StatusNotFound); return
    }

    conn, err := upgrader.Upgrade(w, r, nil)
    if err != nil { return }
    defer conn.Close()

    streamCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(r.Context())
    defer cancel()

    stream, err := h.agentManager.GetInnerSessionStream(streamCtx, nodeID, sessionID)
    if err != nil {
        conn.WriteJSON(map[string]string{"type": "error", "data": err.Error()})
        return
    }
    defer stream.Close()

    // goroutine: PTY stream → WebSocket send
    go func() {
        buf := make([]byte, 4096)
        for {
            n, err := stream.Read(buf)
            if n > 0 {
                conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second))
                conn.WriteJSON(map[string]string{"type": "data", "data": string(buf[:n])})
            }
            if err != nil { cancel(); return }
        }
    }()

    // main loop: browser input → SendInnerInput
    for {
        _, raw, err := conn.ReadMessage()
        if err != nil { break }
        var msg struct{ Type, Data string }
        if json.Unmarshal(raw, &msg) == nil && msg.Type == "input" {
            inputCtx, c := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
            h.agentManager.SendInnerInput(inputCtx, nodeID, sessionID, []byte(msg.Data))
            c()
        }
    }
}

// In setupRoutes() — AFTER the existing /api/v1/ proxy rule:

// ── ADD: WebSocket tunnel to backend.sock ─────────────────────────────────
// httputil.ReverseProxy cannot handle WebSocket upgrades — use raw TCP tunnel.
r.PathPrefix("/ws/").HandlerFunc(newWebSocketTunnel(cfg.BackendSocketPath))

// ── new helper function to add to server.go ───────────────────────────────
func newWebSocketTunnel(socketPath string) http.HandlerFunc {
    return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        backendConn, err := net.Dial("unix", socketPath)
        if err != nil {
            http.Error(w, "backend unavailable", http.StatusBadGateway)
            return
        }
        defer backendConn.Close()

        hijacker, ok := w.(http.Hijacker)
        if !ok { http.Error(w, "hijacking not supported", http.StatusInternalServerError); return }
        clientConn, buf, err := hijacker.Hijack()
        if err != nil { return }
        defer clientConn.Close()

        // Replay the original HTTP request to the backend.
        r.Write(backendConn)
        if n := buf.Reader().Buffered(); n > 0 {
            io.CopyN(backendConn, buf, int64(n))
        }

        // Bidirectional copy — both sides run concurrently; first done cancels both.
        done := make(chan struct{}, 2)
        go func() { io.Copy(backendConn, clientConn); done <- struct{}{}{}() }()
        go func() { io.Copy(clientConn, backendConn); done <- struct{}{}{}() }()
        <-done
    }
}

Two-Tier Supervisor + Inner Agent Architecture for DVE Workspaces
+    Each DVE is auto-provisioned with a dedicated KNIRVAGENT supervisor process on DVE creation.
+    This spec extends that architecture so the KNIRVAGENT supervisor can spawn, monitor, and proxy

- Each DVE already has one KNIRVAGENT supervisor subprocess automatically spawned during

- Unix socket (agent-{dveID}.sock) and exposes POST /api/execute which the
-  KNIRVSERVER proxies over WebSocket to the frontend terminal.
- The goal is to extend this into a two-tier agentic hierarchy:

-
  • Tier 1 (Supervisor): The KNIRVAGENT that already exists. It becomes the
- single point of authority — all inner tool I/O passes through it.

-
  • Tier 2 (Inner Agents): Any agentic CLI tool the user chooses (e.g. Claude Code,
-      Aider, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, Cursor CLI, Sweep, Continue, etc.) launched as a
- supervised child process of KNIRVAGENT inside the DVE workspace.

-

-
  • The KNIRVSERVER backend must expose new routes and a new WebSocket handler for inner agent I/O.

-

+

+

+
